impl-001.question: What classes implement the SessionMsgListener interface? List every implementing class with its source file path.
impl-001.verification_cypher: MATCH (impl:Type)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->(iface:Type {name: 'SessionMsgListener'}) MATCH (a:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(impl) WITH impl, a, CASE WHEN impl.fqn CONTAINS '$' THEN split(a.fileName, '/target/')[0] + '/src/main/java/' + replace(split(impl.fqn, '$')[0], '.', '/') + '.java' ELSE split(a.fileName, '/target/')[0] + '/src/main/java/' + replace(impl.fqn, '.', '/') + '.java' END AS file RETURN DISTINCT impl.name, file
impl-001.notes: 7 implementations across 5 transport modules (coap, http, lwm2m, mqtt, snmp). Two are inner classes (CoapSessionListener, HttpSessionListener). Names like DeviceSessionContext and MqttTransportHandler do not contain 'SessionMsgListener' — grep for 'implements SessionMsgListener' required.

blast-001.verification_cypher: MATCH (caller:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(cm:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(target:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(t:Type {name: 'TransportService'}) WHERE target.name = 'deregisterSession' MATCH (a:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(caller) WITH caller, a, CASE WHEN caller.fqn CONTAINS '$' THEN split(a.fileName, '/target/')[0] + '/src/main/java/' + replace(split(caller.fqn, '$')[0], '.', '/') + '.java' ELSE split(a.fileName, '/target/')[0] + '/src/main/java/' + replace(caller.fqn, '.', '/') + '.java' END AS file RETURN DISTINCT file
blast-001.notes: 6 callers across 5 transport modules (coap, http, lwm2m, mqtt, snmp). One caller is inner class DeviceApiController$SessionCloseOnErrorCallback mapped to outer class file. Method name 'deregisterSession' is unique enough for grep but callers span many modules.

chain-001.question: What service interfaces does DashboardController directly depend on, and what is the concrete implementation class for each? List the controller, every service interface, and every implementation class with their source file paths.
chain-001.verification_cypher: MATCH (ctrl:Type {name: 'DashboardController'})-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(sm:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(svc:Type) WHERE svc:Interface AND svc.name ENDS WITH 'Service' MATCH (a_svc:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(svc) OPTIONAL MATCH (impl:Type)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->(svc) OPTIONAL MATCH (a_impl:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(impl) RETURN DISTINCT svc.name, split(a_svc.fileName, '/target/')[0] + '/src/main/java/' + replace(svc.fqn, '.', '/') + '.java' AS svc_file, impl.name, split(a_impl.fileName, '/target/')[0] + '/src/main/java/' + replace(impl.fqn, '.', '/') + '.java' AS impl_file
chain-001.notes: 15 files: 1 controller + 7 service interfaces + 7 implementations. Services span common/dao-api (4) and application (3). Implementations span dao (4) and application (3). Two-hop traversal: controller -> interface -> implementation.
